name: Treetops Lodge & Estate
insider_take: A wildlife sanctuary meets luxury lodge where native birds literally wake you up and thermal wonders bubble just beyond your suite.
whats_special: Treetops sits on a 2,500-acre private estate that's home to over 40 species of native New Zealand birds, including the rare takahe. The property features its own geothermal hot pools fed by natural springs, and some suites are built on stilts among ancient native trees. It's also a working conservation project - guests can participate in wildlife feeding programs.
pro_tip: Book the Dawn Chorus experience where you'll join the hotel's ornithologist at sunrise to spot rare native birds like tui, bellbirds, and if you're lucky, the elusive North Island robin.
dont_miss: The private thermal pools overlooking the estate at sunset, and the guided night walk to spot glowworms and nocturnal wildlife. The property is also just 10 minutes from Rotorua's famous geothermal attractions like Te Puia and Wai-O-Tapu.
pros: Stunning treetop location with panoramic forest views
Exclusive luxury lodge experience with personalized service
Prime Rotorua location for geothermal and adventure activities
Spacious suites and villas with private terraces
cons: Secluded forest location requires transportation to town
